[SWS_DM_00905] Retrieving data for
external DiagnosticDataElements
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04097
⌈
If the
Diagnostic Server instance
is required to read data configured as
external DiagnosticDataElement
, then the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall utilize the associated
RPortPrototype
typed by the
namespacelist-
dataelement::dataelementinterfacenamex
class and call its
names-
pacelistdataelement::dataelementinterfacenamex::Read
function.
⌋
